Title: Is Herald of Topheth able to play Unleash Hell's Fury?

Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
Is Herald of Topheth able to play [Daimoinon] Unleash Hell's Fury?

I guess the answer is "yes", and maybe this is obvious, but I would still like confirmation for this specific case.

My interpretation:
The Unleash Hell's Fury requires discipline, which triggers "as a vampire" treatment, and since Herald is infernal, it meets all the requirements.

> General Rulings, Allies:
> An ally that plays a card "as a vampire" is treated "as a vampire" for all puposes of the resolution of the play of that card including any continuing effects, but not for effects the card generates for being in play.
>
Cards text:
>
> Herald of Topheth
> Demon with 5 life. 3 strength, 1 bleed, flight [FLIGHT]. Infernal.
> Herald of Topheth can play cards requiring basic Daimoinon [Daimoinon], basic Potence [Potence] and/or basic Presence [Presence] as a vampire with capacity 5. It can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. If it has 4 or fewer life during your unlock phase, it gains 1 life.
>
> Unleash Hell's Fury
> +1 stealth action. Requires an infernal vampire. Unique.
> [Daimoinon] Put this card in play. This card can attempt to block an action directed at you (or a card you control) and is considered a 9-capacity infernal vampire with +2 intercept during that attempt; if successful, the acting minion takes 1 unpreventable environmental aggravated damage and this card is burned.
> [Superior Daimoinon] As above, and unlock this vampire.
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Yes.
